key_concepts: Plants have a root system below ground and a shoot system above ground.
The root system anchors the plant in the soil.
Roots absorb water and nutrients from the soil.
Roots can store energy as starch.
The shoot system includes stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits.
Leaves carry out photosynthesis to make food.
Stems support the plant and transport materials.
Flowers and fruits are involved in reproduction.
Root and shoot systems work together to keep plants alive and growing.
